images.label: Costas
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original muscle-group thumbnail for the Orami fitness app, master illustration for a matching collection. Create a clean horizontal 4:3 illustration with TWO matching full-body anatomical training mannequins, front view on the left, back view on the right. Adult neutral faceless athletic mannequin, approachable semi-cartoon digital illustration, anatomically sensible proportions, relaxed standing pose, arms slightly away from torso, feet fully visible, no cropped head or feet. Soft pearl gray body, subtle charcoal outlines, simple non-gory muscle shapes, no bulging veins or exaggerated bodybuilding, matte charcoal fitted shorts in front; back is an anatomical mannequin with simplified gluteal shapes and no intimate detail. Highlight ONLY THE BACK MUSCLES on the back-view figure in muted warm coral-red: latissimus dorsi, trapezius, rhomboid area and spinal erector areas; shoulder caps, arms, glutes and legs remain pearl gray. The entire front-view figure remains gray. Target regions form precise solid color anatomical shapes with a few subtle fiber lines. Transparent background, no frame, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no arrows, no symbols, no logos or watermark. Two figures equal height occupying 88% of canvas height, centered with generous clean margin. Sharp readable shapes suitable for a final small 512x384 WebP. Clinical fitness illustration inspired by muscle-group diagrams, original artwork rather than a copied infographic.
